why: the risk board says the book cannot be trusted; this face says which pocket of which bar moved after it was printed, and which reader is still holding the earlier printing
statement: 5 of 6 paper traders restated a bar they had already printed (9 events, -51395.05 CNY of equity rewritten). 5 reader/trader gaps are open and 5 of them close against the restatement arithmetic to the cent -- the gap is the restatement, not an arithmetic error.
notes: Only (trader, cutoff) pairs printed with more than one capital signature count as a restatement; a normal bar advance is a new cutoff.
POSITIONS_AND_CASH means marks stayed put while quantities moved -- the shape of a fill booked after the bar was published. CASH_ONLY moves the equity line without touching holdings.
Cause is not determinable from the ledger alone: the paper books carry no trade tape, so this face reports the pocket, never the reason.
A reader whose gap equals the restatement to the cent was reading the pre-restatement printing; one whose gap does not is a separate defect.
